description:
## Context
Issue #780: `packages/ticket-prune/lib/format.mjs:34` unconditionally prints `Stale tickets (N) — re-run with --write to tombstone them:` in dry-run mode, even when the repository uses the canonical sharded directory store (`.adlc/tickets/`) where `--write` archives stale tickets out of the active store via `archiveTicket()`. `plugins/adlc-claude-code/commands/adlc-maintain.md` also describes `--write` as tombstoning in place only.

## Normative Decisions
1. In `packages/ticket-prune/lib/run.mjs`, detect the canonical ticket store before the dry-run return and include `storeKind: "directory" | "legacy"` on `runTicketPrune` result objects (`"directory"` when `canonicalStore instanceof DirectoryTicketStore`, `"legacy"` otherwise). Keep `toJson` keys unchanged so the machine-readable `--json` contract is preserved.
2. In `packages/ticket-prune/lib/format.mjs`, branch the dry-run stale heading on `result.storeKind`: emit `Stale tickets (N) — re-run with --write to archive them out of the active store:` when `storeKind === "directory"`, and `Stale tickets (N) — re-run with --write to tombstone them:` otherwise.
3. Update `plugins/adlc-claude-code/commands/adlc-maintain.md` and `packages/ticket-prune/README.md` so the dry-run / `--write` descriptions accurately state archiving on a directory store and tombstoning on a legacy flat-file store.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: `renderReport` and `runTicketPrune` on a directory store emit `re-run with --write to archive them out of the active store:` in dry-run mode (`verify: node --test packages/ticket-prune/test/format.test.mjs packages/ticket-prune/test/run.test.mjs`).
- AC2: `renderReport` and `runTicketPrune` on a legacy store continue to emit `re-run with --write to tombstone them:` (`verify: node --test packages/ticket-prune/test/format.test.mjs packages/ticket-prune/test/run.test.mjs`).
- AC3: `plugins/adlc-claude-code/commands/adlc-maintain.md` and `packages/ticket-prune/README.md` accurately describe both store behaviors (`verify: node --test packages/ticket-prune/test/json-shape-docs.test.mjs`).
title: ticket-prune: report archive vs tombstone in dry-run output based on detected store kind (#780)
